cards.prompt: Is Washington D.C. part of Washington state?
options: Yes, it is the capital of the state
No, it is an independent district
cards.answer: No. It is an independent district called District of Columbia, not part of any state.

cards.prompt: In which city was Starbucks founded?
Name three reasons Seattle Starbucks prices are among the highest in the US.
cards.answer: Regional rent, local labor wage, and its status as the birthplace of Starbucks.

cards.prompt: A $3.9 latte in Seattle costs only $____ in Mississippi.
Washington D.C. is a state in the US.
cards.answer: Myth: it is a district (District of Columbia), not part of any state.

cards.prompt: A friend says a latte should cost the same at every Starbucks. Using the Seattle example, what do you reply?
cards.answer: Prices vary by region: rent and local wages differ, so a Seattle latte can cost much more than the same one in Mississippi.
